title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world's top innovators, Turing's leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at

Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents' experience.

Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution: Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management: Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation: Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management: Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration: Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience: 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization: Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation: Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management: Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.

Values

  • We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Coordenador de Logística
description:
Sobre a Vaga:

O Coordenador de Logística é responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a aquisição de bens e serviços relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo qualidade, entrega pontual e eficiência de custos. Principais Atribuições:

  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos para operações logísticas (transporte, armazenagem, embalagem, equipamentos e materiais).
  • Realizar análises técnicas e comerciais de propostas para garantir a conformidade com as especificações e padrões de qualidade.
  • Negociar contratos e termos comerciais, visando otimizar o custo total e o prazo de entrega.
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho dos fornecedores (SLA, qualidade, pontualidade, custo), conduzir análises de negócios e estabelecer ações corretivas conforme necessário.
  • Colaborar com as equipes técnicas e operacionais para garantir que as compras atendam aos requisitos logísticos e de produção.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de compras que reduzam riscos e aumentem a eficiência da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Manter atualizado o banco de dados de fornecedores e o mapeamento de mercado.
  • Apoiar o processo orçamentário e as premissas de tendências de mercado.
  • Gerenciar os custos logísticos, incluindo planejados versus reais, por cliente/região e como percentual da receita.
  • Acompanhar a legislação.
  • Implementar as melhores práticas; colaborar com colegas para compartilhar conhecimento e aprendizado, impulsionando a melhoria contínua.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com operações/fábricas, fornecedores e consultores para otimizar gastos por meio de projetos técnicos.
  • Estabelecer uma rotina de Rastreamento e Acompanhamento: monitorar entregas, reclamações, ocorrências e custos extras, se houver.
  • CRM (Gestão de Relacionamento com o Cliente) responsável por Incidentes/Reclamações Logísticas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Logística, Administração de Empresas, Engenharia, Comércio Internacional ou áreas afins.
  • Mais de 10 anos de experiência em compras e gestão de suprimentos na área de logística.
  • Conhecimento técnico de processos logísticos, transporte e armazenagem.
  • Sólidas habilidades de negociação e gestão de contratos.
  • Experiência com compra/negociação de fretes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de apresentação e comunicação em espanhol e inglês.
  • Capacidade de influenciar e obter apoio em situações "de linha pontilhada".
  • Compreende as necessidades do negócio.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

title: GenAI Engineer
description:

As a Software Engineer focused on Artificial Intelligence, you will make a significant contribution to the construction of innovative AI Agents by collaborating closely with your engineering peers. title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:

  • Apoiar iniciativas de employer branding na região LATAM, promovendo a ADM como empregadora de escolha.
  • Ter visão critica na melhoria de processos, suportando e garantindo uma experiência positiva para todos os envolvidos no processo de atração de talentos (Hiring Managers e Candidatos) e alinhada as diretrizes da ADM
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de atração de talentos diversificadas e inclusivas. Propor melhorias de processos, automações e novas ferramentas digitais.
  • Avaliar e acompanhar performance de consultorias, job boards e demais parceiros de recrutamento quando utilizados.
  • Resguardar KPIs relacionado ao processo de atração de talentos, garantindo a qualidade das entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos
  • Liderar projetos de melhoria e/ou inovação dentro do departamento de Talent Acquisition;

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia com Recrutamento & Seleção LATAM
  • Familiaridade com ATS, Pacote Office, Linkedin Recruiter e/ou ferramentas de recrutamento similares
  • Inglês avançado
  • Espanhol avançado
  • Conhecimento em iniciativas de EB e D&I - diferencial

O que nós te oferecemos fazendo parte do time ADM?

  • Aqui, segurança é o nosso primeiro valor, por isso, assim que entrar você passará por uma série de treinamentos para que o seu trabalho seja realizado com a maior segurança possível." Se não for seguro, não faça!"
  • A saúde e bem estar são valores fundamentais, por isso, fique tranquilo, você terá Convênio médico; Convênio odontológico para você e dependentes legais; Seguro de vida e Gympass (auxílio academia).
  • Contamos também com o PAE, apoio social da ADM para questões jurídicas, financeiras e psicológicas;
  • PPR, é como chamamos nossa renda variável anual. (Programa de participação nos resultados)
  • E ainda, incentivamos você a pensar no futuro e por isso você pode contar com a Previdência privada. Mas está tudo bem se você precisar de uma ajuda emergencial, temos o Empréstimo consignado;
  • Vale Refeição ou Refeitório (para plantas) + Vale Alimentação, para te ajudar nas compras de supermercado.
  • Para que você se capacite para alçar vôos ainda mais altos, temos a plataforma de treinamentos e acessos ao Linked in learning. E ainda, você pode contar com o subsídio educacional.
  • Para os papais e mamães temos um auxílio creche que te ajuda a ficar tranquilo para deixar seu pimpolho quando tiver que trabalhar.
  • Vale transporte / Fretado também são benefícios que fazem parte do nosso quadro. A ADM está comprometida em proteger a confidencialidade de quaisquer dados pessoais que você forneça.

ADM coleta e fornece dados sobre os candidatos com o único propósito de utilização de seus dados pessoais durante o processo seletivo e são protegidos contra apropriação e uso indevido, exclusão, acesso não autorizado, divulgação e/ou alteração, de acordo com os propósitos descritos na Política de Privacidade Em caso de dúvidas entre em contato com o responsável pela área de proteção de dados em

Se você estiver recebendo mensagens ou notificações sobre vagas na ADM por meio de terceiros, mensagens de e-mail que não são provenientes de um domínio "@adm.com"; você não deve responder, disseminar, distribuir ou copiar a mensagem. Você deve denunciar imediatamente através da nossa Linha de Ajuda.

#IncluindoVocê

Diversidade, equidade, inclusão e pertencimento são pilares dos esforços da ADM para continuar inovando, impulsionando o crescimento e entregando um desempenho excepcional. Estamos comprometidos em atrair e reter uma força de trabalho diversificada e criar ambientes de trabalho verdadeiramente inclusivos e acolhedores - ambientes que permitem que cada colega da ADM se sinta confortável no trabalho, faça contribuições significativas para nosso sucesso e desenvolva sua carreira. Respeitamos e valorizamos as origens e experiências únicas que cada pessoa pode trazer para a ADM, porque sabemos que a diversidade de perspectivas nos torna melhores, juntos.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company's journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.

In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.

What You'll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.

Nice to have:

  • Golang experience

This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

title: ANALISTA PROJETOS CORPORATIVOS PL
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional altamente qualificado para o cargo de Analista de Projetos Corporativos PL na Almaviva.

Este é um papel estratégico que exige uma combinação de habilidades técnicas, analíticas e de gestão de projetos.

O candidato ideal deverá ter uma forte experiência em gerenciamento de projetos, com um foco particular em iniciativas corporativas de grande escala.

Você será responsável por liderar e gerenciar projetos corporativos, desde a concepção até a implementação e avaliação.

Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão a elaboração de planos de projeto, coordenação de equipes multifuncionais, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos corporativos e o monitoramento do progresso do projeto para garantir que os prazos sejam cumpridos e os orçamentos mantidos.

Além disso, você deverá colaborar com diferentes departamentos para garantir que as necessidades corporativas sejam atendidas e que os projetos sejam concluídos com sucesso.

Experiência em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos como Agile ou Waterfall é altamente desejável.

O candidato deverá demonstrar uma compreensão profunda dos processos de negócios e das ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos.

Habilidades de comunicação e liderança são fundamentais, pois você precisará interagir com equipes internas e externas, bem como com stakeholders de alto nível.

Formação em administração, ciências da computação ou áreas correlatas é necessária, com pós-graduação ou certificações adicionais em gerenciamento de projetos sendo um diferencial.

A AlmavivA valoriza profissionais que não apenas entregam resultados, mas que também promovem um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.

Junte-se à nossa equipe e faça parte de um ambiente que valoriza o crescimento profissional e a inovação contínua.

Se você está pronto para assumir um papel desafiador e impactante, esta é a oportunidade perfeita para você.

title: Bolsista Mestre - Grupo Boticário - Futuro da Beleza - Vaga Afirmativa Para Talentos Diversos | Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.

Projeto: Futuro da Beleza - Vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans)

Sobre a Oportunidade:

No Grupo Boticário, acreditamos que inovar é conectar hoje com o amanhã. O projeto tem como propósito apoiar a equipe de Inovação Estratégica de Produtos na estratégia do projeto Futuro da Beleza, identificando as rotas tecnológicas de produto mais promissoras para os próximos anos. Nosso objetivo é traduzir tendências em oportunidades concretas, transformando ciência e tecnologia em valor para milhões de consumidores.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de explorar territórios de inovação já mapeados, caracterizar e quantificar rotas tecnológicas a partir da análise de ICTs, empresas e startups, além de colaborar com áreas estratégicas como marketing, foresight, categoria (embalagem e formulação) e pesquisa.

O resultado esperado é a conexão entre a estratégia de inovação de curto prazo e as de médio e longo prazo, garantindo maior eficiência na identificação de oportunidades tecnológicas em PD&I. Se você tem perfil analítico, curiosidade para explorar novas fronteiras da ciência e vontade de gerar impacto real no futuro da beleza, que desejam cocriar conosco o amanhã da beleza.

Essa vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans).

Formação Acadêmica: Mestre em Engenharia, Biotecnologia, Química, Farmácia, Analytics, Data Science, Estratégia ou Marketing.

Idioma: Inglês - Nível avançado (leitura).

Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar buscas em bases de dados já pré-definidas na metodologia, mapear e consolidar as tecnologias levantadas.
  • Fazer a análise crítica dos dados obtidos e cruzar com estratégia de inovação do Grupo Boticário.
  • Caracterizar as rotas tecnológicas identificadas de acordo com metodologia pré-definida.
  • Calibrar pesquisa com consumidores e realizar consolidação do material e análise crítica dos resultados.
  • Construir a apresentação do relatório final.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar os dados obtidos e conectá-los com os relatórios estratégicos obtidos e liderados por outras áreas do Grupo Boticário;
  • Curiosidade e proatividade na busca por informações;
  • Capacidade de síntese e comunicação clara;
  • Interesse em inovação e novas tecnologias;
  • Conhecimento em foresight estratégico;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados (google sheets);

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Experiência em foresight estratégico na área;
  • Conhecimento da indústria de cosméticos;
  • Desejável experiência em interpretação de escrita científica;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados (looker);

Soft Skills:

  • Empatia;
  • Espírito de Equipe;
  • Comunicação;
  • Criatividade.
  • Capacidade analítica;

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Node.js- Sênior.

Procuramos alguém com perfil colaborativo, boa comunicação e habilidade para se adaptar a diferentes desafios técnicos e organizacionais. Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Se você curte diversão, energia, alegria, desafios criativos e é uma pessoa organizada, resolutiva, detalhista e orientada a resultados, vem com a gente!

Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end em Node.js, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto.
  • Criar, documentar e integrar APIs RESTful de alta performance utilizando TypeScript e Express.
  • Projetar e otimizar modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL) e/ou NoSQL (MongoDB), garantindo queries performáticas e escalabilidade.
  • Utilizar ORMs como TypeORM, Sequelize ou Prisma para manipulação eficiente do banco de dados.
  • Versionar código com Git, adotando workflows (GitFlow, pull requests, code reviews) e boas práticas de controle de versão.
  • Trabalhar com Docker e docker-compose para criar ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção consistentes e reproduzíveis.
  • Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) usando Jest, Mocha ou similares.
  • Implementar mecanismos de cache (Redis, Memcached) e filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka) para melhorar performance e escalabilidade.
  • Monitorar e depurar aplicações em produção utilizando ferramentas como Node Profiler, Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus.
  • Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) para deploy automatizado em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou Kubernetes.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (front-end, DevOps, QA) em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planning, daily e retrospectivas.

Resquisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com Node.js e TypeScript, aplicando padrões de projeto (Factory, Repository, Dependency Injection) e estruturação modular (Clean Architecture, DDD).
  • Uso de Express (ou NestJS/Koa) para construção de APIs, dominando rotas, middlewares, tratamento de erros e validação de payload (class-validator, Joi, Celebrate).
  • Gerenciamento de pacotes com npm ou yarn, versionamento semântico (semver) e controle de dependências.
  • Testes Automatizados: domínio de frameworks como Jest ou Mocha + Chai, testes de integração (supertest) e uso de mocks/fakes.
  • Escalabilidade e Desempenho: experiência em cache (Redis), filas de mensagens (RabbitMQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) e otimizações de consultas em bancos relacionais (índices, partições).
  • Performance e Debugging: uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.
  • Integração Contínua e Deploy: prática com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) e deploy em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou ambientes Kubernetes.
  • Docker Avançado: criação de imagens otimizadas, multi-stage builds e configuração de docker-compose para desenvolvimento e produção.
  • Banco de Dados Relacional Avançado: MySQL ou PostgreSQL (índices, query profiling, replicação, particionamento).
  • APIs Performáticas e Seguras: experiência com GraphQL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.
  • Git Profundo: workflows GitFlow, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick e estratégias de branching para times grandes.

Habilidades:

  • Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony): será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.
  • Experiência com React (ou Next.js): habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).
  • Frameworks Node.js avançados: NestJS (dependency injection, modules, providers), Koa ou Fastify para cenários de alta concorrência.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): conhecimento em Terraform ou CloudFormation para provisionamento de ambientes AWS.

title: Collections Lead
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As Collections lead, you will own the strategy that protects liquidity and strengthens trust in the Credix ecosystem. Operations runs the day-to-day recoveries; your role is to define the strategy, policy, and data intelligence that make those efforts precise, fair, and scalable. You'll guide how we balance recovery and relationships, when to engage, when to escalate, and when to step back.

You'll refine our existing policy and performance frameworks, turning data into foresight and our network data into leverage - ensuring that Credix's collections model becomes a competitive advantage, not just a control function.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in credit recovery in the context of Brazilian SMEs.
  • Proficiency with SQL and BI tools.
  • Ability to interpret cohort data and design actionable segmentation strategies.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazil's legal and judicial collection frameworks.
  • Clear communicator; able to translate data into field-ready direction.
  • Collaborative but decisive - able to guide Operations while respecting ownership.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a bias toward execution.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Responsibilities

  • Own the collections strategy and policy across all product lines.
  • Guide Operations: ensure day-to-day execution follows data-backed policy and economic logic.
  • Oversee complex recoveries and litigation, directly managing negotiations on high-value or reputationally sensitive cases.
  • Partner with the Data team to evolve our analytics layer - feeding insights from collections into credit models and underwriting.
  • Optimise the economic model of recovery: continuously measure ROI per effort type and segment.
  • Manage external partners (law firms, collection agencies) with a clear view of cost, compliance, and outcome quality.
  • Report and communicate results clearly to leadership and investors - recovery performance, portfolio health, and systemic learnings.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you'll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that's just the beginning - here's what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you're well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Business Systems Analyst

We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.

You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You're comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don't interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes.   • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.

title: Technical Solution Engineer - Sao Paulo
description:
About CATL

CATL invites you to continue our legend of green energy!

CATL is a World Fortune 300 Company, a global leader who provides premier EV battery and energy storage battery for the world. CATL's EV battery consumption volume has ranked No.1 in the world for seven consecutive years and global energy storage battery shipment has also ranked No.1 for three consecutive years.

Job Description

ESS Technical Solution Engineer is the combination of application engineer and sales engineer. A technical solution engineer should support and service the customer by demonstrating the product function, technical benefits and value to help customer meet their company and business goals and help company to win projects. Combining technical knowledge with strong communication and interpersonal skills, work closely with clients, understanding their specific needs, and then leverage their in-depth understanding of the company's products or services to provide tailored solutions that meet those needs effectively. Additionally, technical solution engineers should gather feedback from clients and bridge the gap between internal development team and customer requirements, helping to refine products and services based on customer needs and experiences.

Responsibilities:

  • Product Demonstration: Deep understanding of the products or services of products and company. Be able to explain complex technical concepts to clients in a clear and understandable manner and contribute to sales presentations, as well as demonstrating products benefits, value and completed applications
  • Client Engagement: Interact directly with clients to understand their needs, challenges, and requirements as well as the competition information from the competitors. Engage in discussions to gather information, analyze the client's projects and requirements, and identify opportunities where company's solutions can add value to win the opportunities
  • Solution Development: Once understand the client's needs, sales engineers work to develop solutions that align with the client's projects. This may involve collaborating with the technical team to design tailored solutions that address specific challenges. Provide clients with technical support as needed and relay information to our development teams for product development and update needs
  • Proposal Creation: Create detailed proposals that outline the proposed solution and its benefits. These proposals need to address the technical aspects while also highlighting the business value for the client as well as prepare the documents according to customer requirements which may include specifications, user's manual, disposal proposal, etc.,
  • Technical Support: Provide ongoing technical support to clients, answering questions, addressing concerns, and helping with any technical issues that arise
  • Technical Agreement Negotiations: Involve in negotiations with clients, addressing any technical concerns, clarifying expectations, and ensuring that both parties are aligned on the proposed solution to form final technical agreement
  • Risk Assessment and Problem Solving: Identify the possible issues ahead and provide preventative solutions for the risks. Resolve the technical issues during manufacturing, delivering and commissioning until successfully hand over to customer. Cooperate with internal development and project management team if needed
  • Market Research: Stay informed about market trends, competitor offerings, and customer feedback. Generate ideas for product and service improvement and innovation based on market trends and customer inputs

Requirements and skills:

  • Based in (or open to relocation) Sao Paulo
  • At least 2 years work experience in local ESS market
  • Previous work experience as an AE or SE of ESS market is advantageous
  • Previous experience in utility or ESS developer company is advantageous
  • Knowledge of local ESS projects development requirements is advantageous
  • Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent market and competitor analysis abilities
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Superb collaboration and communication
  • Superb logical and strategic thinking abilities
  • Proficient in English & Portuguese

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:

HBX Group is the world's leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We're game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to 'move fast, dream big and make the difference' every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our 'global approach, local touch' mentality. We're headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.

We are seeking a Global Contact Center Executive to join our dynamic Contact Center team. In this role, you will support our clients and suppliers, contributing to one of our core missions: delivering unique holiday experiences to our customers. This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí.

Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. The goal is to address client needs efficiently and effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures.
  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong customer service orientation and active listening skills.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with attention to grammar and clarity.
  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.

If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!

Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.

At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school's mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.

Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.

ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC's mission and values.

Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.

Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Instructional Support and Student Learning

Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.

Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.

Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.

Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.

Student Care and Learning Environment

Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.

Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.

Operational and School Support

Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.

Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.

Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.

Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.

Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.

Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed.

Professional Conduct and Growth

Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.

Additional Responsibilities

Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school's commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.

Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school.

Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.

Working Conditions

Walk on paths and rough terrain

Lifting backpacks and school materials

Other duties, as assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
  • Five years experience working with children, preferred
  • PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
  • English level required: B2 or above
  • Portuguese level required: B2 or above

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
  • Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
  • Strong professional organization skills

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC's Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Data Analyst (Sales Focus)
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world's largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc's Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.

Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • The Data Feeds team manages the data feeds business at YipitData. We partner with systematic and quantamental investment firms by providing access to alternative data for investment analytics and model development.
  • Become part of a growing team where your ideas and collaboration will have a direct impact on how we deliver value to top-tier investment firms.

About The Role:

YipitData seeks a proactive, analytically minded Sales Engineer with +2 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role will directly influence the growth of our data feed revenue. As a Sales Engineer, you will provide our clients with operational and quantitative development support, enabling them to utilize and evaluate YipitData's data feeds effectively.

We expect East Coast work hours.

As Our Sales Engineer, You Will:

  • Provide operational support during client onboarding, with a strong focus on the setup, configuration, and integration of complex data feeds (40% daily focus).
  • Partner closely with Sales to drive product adoption by delivering demonstrations, analyses, and explanations of complex data feeds to clients.
  • Address client queries and maintain strong relationships by ensuring our data solutions align closely with clients' investment strategies.
  • Develop quantitative documentation, scripts, and use-case examples to facilitate client evaluations, integrations, and ongoing data usage (60% daily focus).
  • Collaborate with Product to improve product features based on client feedback.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline or finance-related field.
  • Experience in financial markets (Nice to have); excellent client-facingcommunication skills.
  • Experience working with US clients is highly preferred
  • Proficiency in Python (preferred), SQL, Databricks (preferred), Jupyter, and AWS (Knowledge focused on answering clients' questions).

What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.

Acompanhar o controle de perdas e desempenho de equipamentos e máquinas, verificar necessidade de manutenção e investimentos em equipamentos, cumprir programas de limpeza, organização e qualidade implantados, registrar boletins de processos da área, executar a organização, higiene e limpeza de áreas industriais, prestando auxílio na limpeza da área e de equipamentos, e participar de DDS e ginastica laboral junto aos demais colegas de trabalho realizar atividades extras relacionadas

ao cargo.

Tailândia/PA

Nossa Empresa

Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos. Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos). Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

  • Análise de impactos de tarifas, impostos e regulações aduaneiras (Recof, Ex-Tarifário, alterações de Incoterm), consolidando ganhos e perdas no resultado.
  • Suporte em BID/RFQ de transportadoras, avaliando cenários financeiros, savings potenciais e impactos no budget/forecast.
  • Monitoramento de KPIs financeiros logísticos, como custo por tonelada/km, saturação de caminhões, waiting hours e demurrage, consolidando dashboards para decisão.

Requisitos:

Superior completo.

Experiência em finanças e controladoria, com sólidos conhecimentos contábeis.

Experiência com melhoria de processos e implementação de melhores práticas.

Experiência em suporte a auditorias e garantia de conformidade com a SOX e controles internos.

Experiência em ambientes multinacionais, com relatórios e colaboração entre equipes globais.

Experiência prática com análise financeira, previsão e planejamento estratégico (FP&A).

title: Corporate Finance Analyst
description:
About Us

Founded in 2011, QMC owns and operates thousands of wireless infrastructure assets, all the way from traditional Towers to DAS (Distributed Antenna Systems), SLS (Street Level Solutions ) and Stealth solutions, across Latin America. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring – Snowflake Lead Developer (Azure & ADF)

Location: Remote in Brazil

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 7–10 years total experience | 2–3 years hands-on Snowflake

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Snowflake Lead Developer with strong expertise in Azure Data Factory (ADF) and data engineering best practices. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing and developing scalable data architectures, building ETL/ELT pipelines, and optimizing complex SQL workloads within cloud-based environments.

You will play a key role in leading Snowflake development, implementing data transformation logic, and ensuring high-quality data delivery for analytics and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and optimization of data solutions within Snowflake.
  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and IICS (Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services).
  • Design and implement data models, schemas, and stored procedures (SnowProc, SnowSQL) to support complex business logic and transformations.
  • Write efficient, high-performing SQL queries for data integration and analytics.
  • Collaborate with architects and data engineers to define data architecture and governance standards.
  • Implement robust error handling, monitoring, and logging mechanisms for data pipelines.
  • Support CICD implementation using Git/Bitbucket and Visual Studio for code versioning and deployment.
  • Work closely with onsite teams and provide production support when required.
  • Apply data engineering best practices, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Optional: Utilize Airflow or Control-M for workflow orchestration and scheduling.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 7–10 years of overall experience in data engineering or BI development.
  • 2–3 years of strong hands-on experience in Snowflake (data architecture, analytics, and development).
  • Mastery of SQL — deep experience writing optimized, complex queries in large-scale environments.
  • Expertise in SnowProc and SnowSQL, including writing Snowflake stored procedures and scripts for transformations.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for orchestrating data pipelines.
  • Proficiency in IICS (Informatica Cloud) for data extraction, transformation, and loading into Snowflake.
  • Familiarity with data integration, modeling, and ETL/ELT best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with CICD pipelines, version control (Git/Bitbucket), and Visual Studio.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours to coordinate with global teams.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Airflow or Control-M for workflow scheduling.
  • Experience working in implementation and support projects.
  • Exposure to data governance, metadata management, or cloud cost optimization.

title: Plant Manager. Cabo de Santo Agostinho. PLASTICS TRANSFORMATION PROCESSES
description:
Join us at Orbia Building & Infrastructure Amanco Wavin Brazil: Where purpose comes to life.

You're purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. Welcome to Orbia's Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, where our purpose 'to advance life around the world' drives our entire global team.

Every day, we are thinking big and working smart to solve some of the toughest challenges impacting the world. Whether it's facilitating clean drinking water for communities, creating climate resilient cities, or designing more comfortable living spaces, we never settle for "good enough" when there's an opportunity to make life better.

Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we work for. How about you?

At Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin), we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments. And where is our help most needed? The places we live in: cities where drinking water is leaking away, greenery is disappearing, streets are flooding after heavy rain, and outdated sewer systems are polluting our groundwater. It's time to join our team and help build more sustainable environments!

We are currently looking for a Plant Manager to join us at Cabo de Santo Agostinho, Pernambuco, Brazil, in the Suape industrial complex . If you want to make a difference and work for a purpose-led company, please read on.

About the role:

The plant manager is responsible for managing the daily operations of the plant. This includes planning and coordinating production activities, managing a team of production department heads, supervisors and workers, and ensuring that the plant operates safely and efficiently. The production plant manager will also be responsible for controlling plant costs, improving production efficiency, and establishing and maintaining relationships with suppliers, customers, and other stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee plant operations such as budget, production schedule and stock.
  • Analyze production costs and inventory to establish areas for improvements
  • Ensure adherence to rules and workplace policies and HSE.
  • Lead improvement initiatives as aligned with global guidance , such as Lean and Operational Excellence, and other projects to improve quality, reduce costs, improve OEE, save time.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or relevant field. (Nice to have: Lean Six Sigma certification)
  • 5+ years of experience in field as a Plan Manager in manufacturing (in Plastic transformation processes).
  • Professional English level (is a key requirement), the interviews will be in English
  • Experience in plant management and manufacturing operations, budget, Strong communication, management and supervisory skills.
  • The candidate will also have an ability to follow safety and compliance guidelines diligently in order to create a healthy work environment for all employees.

What Orbia Building & Infrastructure offers

Do you want to make a difference by working with a purpose? Count on a warm welcome at Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin)! Here we take responsibility for each other and our company. We stay brave in pursuing calculated risks that fuel innovation. And we embrace diversity in perspectives, skills and talents to transform the way we work and the impact we have on the world. Above all we encourage all our employees to develop their talents and to become the best version of themselves. Together, as a strong team, we grow and deliver on our purpose every day. Orbia B&I is the place to be if you truly wish to make an impact. In addition to working with an enthusiastic, professional team in an international environment, we offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.

Organization

Orbia's Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, is an innovative solutions provider for the global building and infrastructure industry. Backed by more than 60 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments for global citizens. Whether it's to improve the distribution of clean drinking water, to make sanitation accessible for everyone, to create climate resilient cities, or to design comfortable living spaces, Orbia B&I collaborates with municipal leaders, engineers, contractors, and installers to help future-proof communities, buildings and homes. Orbia B&I has 11,000+ employees and 65 production sites worldwide, serving over 80 countries through a global sales and distribution network. Our key commercial brands are: Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, Plastigama Wavin, and Bow Wavin.

Orbia Building & Infrastructure is part of Orbia – a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in several sectors including: Polymer Solutions (Vestolit and Alphagary), Building and Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura). These five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on expanding access to health and wellness, reinventing the future of cities and homes, ensuring food and water security, connecting communities to information and accelerating a circular economy with basic and advanced materials, specialty products and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 24,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam and Tel Aviv. The company generated $8.2 billion in revenue in 2023.

title: Business Intelligence Partner
description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil

about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.

job context

and purpose

Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the 'BI consumers. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.

Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients

Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client's data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met

job

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree a plus

Mandatory Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience
  • MI/Business Intelligence/Data Science/Analytics background
  • Proficient with an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to turn ambiguous information and unstructured challenges into substantive insights.

Preferred Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Industry exposure to business process outsourcing and/or workforce planning (e.g., MSP/RPO)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Excellent working knowledge of MS - Excel with knowledge of macros and pivot tables.
  • Excellent working knowledge of Google products, and visualization tools Tableau, etc.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, tasks, and meet deadlines while maintaining quality
  • Ability to synthesize and analyze information and ideas

  • Ability to create meaningful insights and metrics that aligned to business priorities and objectives
  • Data visualization preferred; ability to interpret data and translate it to non-tech people.
  • Ability to write Intermediate SQL scripts

title: Linguistics Expert
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.

Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.

Qualifications:

  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:
  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency

Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development

Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group ("Perseus").

Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.

Location: Brazil

The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus' acquisition of software companies.

The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.

Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.

Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Site Readiness Engineer
description:
About Pathlock:

Pathlock is a leader in application security, access governance, and compliance automation. Our cloud-based solutions help organizations secure critical applications, mitigate risk, and enforce policies across a diverse IT landscape.

Job Summary:

We are looking for a skilled Site Readiness Engineer (SRE) with expertise in CI/CD automation and Azure cloud technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring deployment readiness across our infrastructure, automating deployment processes, and maintaining optimal site performance within our cloud environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support application deployment and infrastructure provisioning.
  • Develop and enhance automation scripts to streamline deployment processes and minimize manual tasks.
  • Configure, manage, and optimize cloud resources in alignment with security standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to troubleshoot and resolve deployment and site readiness issues.
  • Monitor site performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement improvements to enhance system reliability and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide production deployment support and incident resolution.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation for deployment processes, system configurations, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Conduct site readiness assessments and validation tests to ensure infrastructure and applications are production ready.
  • Implement and enforce Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using tools such as Terraform and ARM templates.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to deployment failures, infrastructure provisioning, and application performance.

Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of experience in site reliability engineering, DevOps, or similar roles
  • Strong proficiency in CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, or similar
  • Solid experience with Azure cloud services, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Database services and networking controls
  • Hands-on experience automating deployment workflows and infrastructure provisioning
  • Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, ARM templates, or similar tools
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar
  • Experience with GitOps tools like ArgoCD or Flux
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Strong understanding of networking principles and Azure networking services
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments
  • Must be able to read and speak fluently in English
  • Must be able to work at least some time in the US or EU time zone

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Azure certifications (Azure Developer Associate, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, or Azure Administrator)
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as , Application Insights, ELK or Grafana
  • Experience with log aggregation and analysis tools in particular Elastic and Prometheus
  • Understanding of high availability and disaster recovery concepts
  • Experience with containerized applications with a Windows OS

Why Join Pathlock?

  • Opportunity to lead a cutting-edge cloud security platform.
  • Work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and equity options.
  • Collaborative and inclusive company culture.

•SQL básico: Você sabe fazer queries com SELECT, JOINs e manipulação fundamental de dados.

•Curiosidade e vontade de aprender: Disposição para explorar novas tecnologias, frameworks e metodologias de desenvolvimento.

DIFERENCIAIS QUE VÃO TE DESTACAR:

•Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipe: Habilidade para interagir e colaborar efetivamente em projetos.

•Interesse em aprender sobre desenvolvimento de sistemas corporativos: Motivação para atuar em um ambiente de negócios complexo e desafiador.

•Conhecimentos em Git/GitHub: Familiaridade com controle de versão e colaboração em projetos de código.

•Projetos pessoais com .NET: Experiência prática na construção de pequenas aplicações ou protótipos utilizando a plataforma.

•Já brincou com mapas: experiência com ArcGIS ou análise de dados geográficos;

POR QUE ESTA OPORTUNIDADE É ÚNICA?

•Stack tecnológico de ponta: C#, .NET, SQL Server/PostgreSQL, ferramentas de CI/CD e metodologias ágeis.

•Aprendizado acelerado: Você estará imerso em tecnologias (desenvolvimento web, backend, dados, automação).

•Impacto real: Seu trabalho apoiará diretamente a eficiência e inovação de processos de negócio.

•Visão estratégica do negócio: Entender a conexão entre tecnologia, requisitos de negócio e soluções de software.

•Projetos desafiadores: Participar do desenvolvimento de sistemas robustos, escaláveis e de alta performance.

•Portfólio diferenciado: Construir projetos que combinam desenvolvimento de software, gestão de dados e arquitetura de sistemas.

title: Coordenador de SMS
